name: agentsecrets_call
description: Call an HTTPS API with AgentSecrets-injected credentials. Pass secret KEY NAMES only. Values never enter the model or this tool.

injections.description: Map of injection spec to secret KEY NAME. Specs: bearer, basic, header:Name, query:param, body:json.path, form:field. Never pass a value.

body.description: Request body as a string. Use JSON for body: and form: injections.

environment.description: Asserts the expected environment: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter, 2 to 32 characters. Standard names are development, staging, production; other valid names are custom and resolve on Pro plans only. Cloud checks the token binding; local checks the active CLI environment.

path.description: Local project directory. Defaults to the process working directory.

agent_id.description: Agent name for audit attribution. Defaults to plugin.
